name: Sidonians The
overview: The Sidonians, descended from Sidon, the firstborn of Canaan, were a people dwelling along the sea coast bordering the land of Canaan (Genesis 10:15; 10:19). Their territory was adjacent to Israel’s northern borders, as seen in the allotment to the tribe of Asher (Genesis 49:13; Joshua 19:24). Though God gave their land to Israel and Israel was commanded to drive them out, the Sidonians remained a significant presence, often hostile and idolatrous, resisting Israel's efforts to expel them (Joshua 11:8; 13:6).
